headline: African Rainbow Capital to Increase Stake in Alexforbes to 77.94% as Prudential Exits
summary: African Rainbow Capital is set to increase its stake in financial services group Alexforbes to 77.94% following the exit of Prudential Financial amid strong interim financial results.
why: Consolidating majority ownership in an established financial services provider allows parent investment holding companies to capture a larger share of dividend yields.

impacts.name: African Rainbow Capital
impacts.why: Acquiring a departing partner's stake increases the company's equity ownership percentage.
